description: Moves one positioned image above all other image objects in the document. Implements IDocumentEditorCommand, so it is asynchronous and undoable: ExecuteAsync() applies the new z-index and UndoAsync() restores the previous one. Note that Tempo.Blazor.Wireframe has a same-named command with a different signature.

members.name: BringToFrontCommand
members.type: BringToFrontCommand(DocumentEditorDocument document, string blockId, string? description = null)
members.description: Creates the command for the image block identified by blockId. The description labels the undo step and defaults to "Bring image to front".

members.name: Description
members.description: Human-readable command description for tooltips and diagnostics.

members.name: ExecuteAsync
members.description: Applies the new z-index to the image.

members.name: UndoAsync
members.description: Restores the z-index captured before ExecuteAsync() ran.
